Corrected the five #699 findings in `benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.json` and `.md` with targeted edits only. No evaluator, builder or checker was run.

Final SHA256 (the verification one-liner printed OK):
- JSON `74c9a47ab4966f79aec887f7bd72b1dd418cd8f0d9e9af13e6240baaf9690e6f`
- MD `8b2b30e63fd095dcdbc1aeb52ad14886d99035107a84fcd5183fb43119a35436`

| # | JSON pointer | Markdown section |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Removed `verification_receipt_ref` from `/freeze_receipt/fields`. Added `/freeze_receipt/verification_receipt_note`: the verification receipt is cited only from ledger events (step 8). | Receipt, ledger and acyclic binding |
| 2 | `/review_handoff` no longer points at the uninspectable expectations file. | Author application findings: the 35 traces, 631 events and 28 negative controls are marked withdrawn. Review handoff: the pointer is removed. |
| 3 | `/event_types/usage_reconciled/payload` now records actual tokens_in/out, time_s and calls, `reserved_ref`, `delta`, `overrun` and `remaining_after`. New rule V29 covers overrun. | Receipt, ledger and acyclic binding (V29 summary) |
| 4 | V30: freeze_utc precedes the first event and every dispatch. V31: `preflight_result` is seq 1 and appears once. V32: UTC order within recovery segments. | same |
| 5 | New `/answer_class_values`: ok, interrupted, unsupported, absent, empty, invalid_utf8, malformed, legacy_invalid, truncated, exhausted, error, failed_tool_call. New `/plan_states/phase_mapping` maps policy ready/running onto ledger phases pre/open/stopped/blocked/terminal. `/plan_states/nonterminal` is now pre/open/stopped/blocked. New rules V33 (answer_class vocabulary) and V34 (phase mapping). | same |

The new rules V29–V34 follow V28 and appear in both files. Only these two files changed.

F-A1 (V20 redundant with V17) and F-A2 (slot-level NONE) are still open for an owner decision. Both are noted as open in the Markdown and the JSON.

## Discoveries
- Grep and a line scan of `attempt-policy-0148.md` found no literal I03/I04 text. The `answer_class` list is therefore taken from the #699 list. The mapping to I03/I04 is not independently confirmed, and the JSON says so in `/answer_class_values/note`.
- I added `truncated`, `exhausted`, `error` and `failed_tool_call` to `answer_class` because the closure rule already names them. The reviewer should check whether that goes beyond finding 5.
- The V34 rule says ready/running are both phase `open`, split by whether a first dispatch exists. The `ready` description in `phase_mapping` is wordy and may need tightening in review.

## What next
Order a changed-scope review of the two files at the hashes above. It should check the V29–V34 wording and the I03/I04 mapping.
